header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: Instructions given to be carried out. A command differs from a request by not leaving the answer open.
A remark set beside a thing rather than inside it. It explains without becoming part of what it explains.
The exchange of goods and services at scale. Commerce is the machinery; whether it extracts or circulates is a design choice.
A promise that binds the one who made it. A commitment costs exactly when keeping it becomes inconvenient.
The recorded steps of a repo's history, spoken plural — each one a promise written down; they ride KP's word alone.
Written into the record — a change made history; and, of a person, given wholly.
Shared by all, and frequently occurring. The same word for what belongs to everyone and what is unremarkable.
Meaning carried from one to another and arriving intact. Speaking is not communication; being understood is.
A body of people bound by something held in common. Not proximity but sharing is what makes it one.
Taking little room for what it holds. Also an agreement between parties — both are things drawn tight.
One who goes alongside. Companionship is defined by presence rather than by function.
The being alongside another. Companionship is defined by presence rather than by usefulness.
That which decides which of two comes first. A comparator encodes an ordering someone chose.
To set two things side by side to see how they differ. Comparison needs a shared axis, and naming it is the method.
The setting of two things side by side to see how they differ. Comparison requires a shared axis, and naming it is the whole method.
Whether two things can work together without harm. Compatibility is a property of the pair, never of either alone.
Able to work together without harm. Compatibility is a property of the pair, never of either alone.
Having nothing missing. Completeness is a claim that must be checked, since a set can feel whole and not be.
The state of nothing being missing. Completeness is a claim requiring a check, since a set can feel whole and not be.
The state of having nothing left to do. Completion must be defined in advance or it never arrives.
How many parts interact, and how tangled their interaction is. Complexity is not difficulty; it is the number of ways to be wrong.
The meeting of a standard imposed from outside. Compliance is not agreement; it is conformity.
A part that keeps its own shape inside a larger whole. A component can be taken out and still be itself.
To put parts together so the whole says more than the parts. Composition is arrangement with intent.
One who sets parts into a whole meant to be performed.
Made of several parts that keep their identity within the whole. A composite is joined rather than merged.
How parts are put together so the whole says more than they do. Also a made work — both are arrangement with intent.
Covering the whole of what it claims to cover. A comprehensive claim is one that can be disproved by a single gap.
Making a thing smaller while keeping what matters. Every compression decides what mattered.
To work out by fixed steps. Also the capacity to do so — the same word for the act and the resource.
A named idea not yet embodied — meaning that runs ahead of machinery, lawfully.
To bring to its close and its meaning at once — the end that says what the whole was.
Particular and touchable rather than general. Of a thing you could point at.
The state a thing is in, and the requirement that must hold for something else to follow. Both are about what is presently the case.
Depending on something else holding. A conditional makes what follows contingent rather than certain.
One who holds the timing of many so they sound as one. The conductor plays nothing and decides everything.
A bounded way something is carried through. A conduit holds nothing of its own.
A misspelling of context as it stands in this library's own names. Recorded as found rather than silently corrected.
How sure one is, held apart from how right one is. Confidence and accuracy are separate measures and must be reported separately.
Configuration shortened to its working name — the declared choices a system reads before it acts. A config is a promise about behavior, written down where hands can find it.
The particular settings a system is currently arranged into. Choices made once and then held, until someone changes them.
To set the choices a system will run under. Configuration is decisions made once and then held.
To say back that a thing is so. Confirmation turns an assumption into a shared fact.
A saying-back that establishes a thing was received and is so. Confirmation is what turns an assumption into a shared fact.
That which says back that a thing was received and holds. Confirmation turns an assumption into a shared fact.
Two things that cannot both hold. A conflict is a fact about incompatibility, not about ill will.
Two words run together in this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Joined so that one can reach the other. Connection holds two things together while leaving them two.
A binding that holds two things together while leaving them two. From tying, not from merging.
Able to join what was separate. A connective carries nothing of its own; its whole worth is what it lets pass.
That which joins two things so they can reach each other. A connector holds no content of its own.
Aware, and aware of being aware. Its root is knowing-with — the Latin says two parties share what is known.
Knowing that one knows. Its root is not solitary awareness but KNOWING WITH - the Latin says two parties share what is known.
Holding the same way across cases and across time. Consistency is not correctness — a thing can be reliably wrong.
To bring scattered things into one solid whole. Consolidation reduces the count and should not reduce the content.
A value that does not change while everything around it may — the fixed star code navigates by. Declared once, trusted everywhere.
Separate lights held as one figure by those who look. The pattern is real and lives in the seeing, not in the stars.
Held within limits. Constraint narrows what is possible and is often what makes a design decidable.
A limit that shapes what is possible. Constraints are not only obstacles — they are what makes a design decidable.
A touching between two things. Also the person reachable through it, named for the touch rather than the bond.
That which holds other things and gives them a bound. From holding-together, the same root as content and contentment.
What a thing holds inside it. From the same root as contentment - to be content is to have one's wants bounded by what is already held.
The surrounding truth a thing is understood within. Nothing in this Grammar means alone; context is the room a meaning stands in.
The largest landmasses, each holding many places under one name. Division at the coarsest scale.
The holding of a thread unbroken across change. Continuity is what makes a later moment belong to the same story as an earlier one.
Without break or step. Continuity is what makes a later moment belong to the same thing as an earlier one.
A range with no steps in it, where every point shades into the next. Continua resist the categories laid over them.
How much two things differ where they meet. Contrast is what makes anything legible at all.
What one party adds to a common thing. A contribution is named from the giving side and measured on the common one.
One who adds to a common work. This house prefers participant where the person is the source rather than the helper.
The power to determine how something behaves, and the means of exercising it. Control implies someone holds it, and that it can be handed over.
That which decides how a thing behaves and directs it. A controller holds authority rather than doing the work.
Ease bought by someone having done work in advance. Convenience is never free; it was paid for earlier.
A practice agreed rather than required. A convention is not a rule, and treating it as one is a common error.
Separate paths arriving at the same place. Convergence is evidence when the paths were truly independent.
Speech turned between two or more, where each shapes what the other says next. A conversation is built, not delivered.
To change a thing from one form into another while keeping what it holds. Conversion preserves content and not always fidelity.
Small records a site leaves on a visitor's device. They make convenience possible and are also how people are followed.
A required wait before a thing may be done again. A cooldown protects what repetition would exhaust.
A number locating a point along an axis. Coordinates only mean something against a stated origin.
The bringing of separate actors into working agreement. Coordination costs attention and prevents far more expensive collisions.
A second thing identical to the first. Also written text prepared for publishing — both are reproductions of something.
The maker's standing to decide how their work is copied and used. A right held by default and often signed away.
A line that ties and carries — the quipus' own word for a thread of knotted meaning between two beings.
The centre a thing cannot be without. Remove the core and what remains is no longer the same thing.
Short form of corporation, and of corpus. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Bodies of collected text taken together as material to study. A corpus is defined by what was gathered, and its edges are a decision.
A body of collected text taken as material to study. Its edges are a decision someone made.
In accordance with what is so. Also to make it so — the same word for the state and for the repair.
Changes made after an error is found. In this house corrections go beneath the record, dated, never inside it.
To match across a distance — one thing answering another's shape; and to exchange letters, which is the same thing between people.
What things ask in exchange, spoken plural — price in money, tokens, or effort, counted honestly.
A body called together to deliberate. From the shout that summons - a council is not a group that exists, but a group that was CALLED.
To number things one by one. Counting is the difference between believing a set is complete and knowing its size.
That which keeps a running count. Also to oppose — the same word for tallying and for standing against.
A path followed, and a structured body of teaching. Both are routes laid out in advance.
Bonded by sharing — held together by what both parties give into the space between them.
A gathered group practising together, small enough that everyone is known. Its root is the same as convene — a coven is people who come together.
A promise binding both sides, held by their own word rather than by force. A covenant survives because the parties keep it, not because it is enforced.
What is laid over a thing to protect or conceal it. Also the outward face a work is met by.
How much of a whole has actually been reached. Coverage is the honest answer to how complete a pass really was.
Holding back with a smile — reluctance worn playfully; disclosure that makes you ask twice.
To bring into being what was not there before. In this house creation is additive by law — a create never overwrites; it opens a new room.
The bringing forth of what was not there. Creation adds to the world rather than rearranging it.
Bringing forth what was not there. Of work whose value is in its newness rather than its correctness.
One who brings a work into being. In this house the creator keeps sovereignty over what they made.
A point at which what happens next decides which way things go. Its root is decision — a crisis is a turning, not merely a bad time.
The standard a judgment is made against. Without a stated criterion, a judgment cannot be checked or disputed.
At the point where failure follows. Also examining carefully — the same word for a danger and for the rigour that prevents it.
To go over from one side to another. Also the mark made where two lines meet.
The four basic acts on stored things: create, read, update, delete. A named shorthand rather than a concept.

Creation — the bringing of shape into being, from cruth, "form." The act, not its product: what is cruthú is being made, and the word does not wait for it to be finished. Irish. This house's graphic studio.

A cylinder whose lettered rings must be turned to spell the word that opens it. A coined word, crypt + codex. The container and the password are one object: the answer is not kept inside the lock, the answer IS the lock.
Matter whose structure repeats in perfect order, so its shape shows its nature. A lesson compressed until it can be carried.
The language that says how a document should look. A named tool rather than a concept.
A plain format holding rows of values separated by commas. Simple enough to outlive every tool that reads it.
Short form of count, and of Connecticut. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
A call to action — the place a surface asks the reader to do something. Naming it makes the asking honest.
Short form of context — what is woven alongside a thing and gives it meaning. A named abbreviation.
Small signs that tell a mind what to do next. A cue works by being noticed without being read.
Fitting a thing to the culture that will meet it, beyond translating its words. Meaning made at home rather than merely legible.
What a group holds in common without having to say. Culture is the part of a system that is never written down.

The Irish book-shrine — the ornamented case made for a book already sacred; it honors the text and never speaks over it. In the Sanctuary: the shell that wraps a living thing without ever being the thing. Irish joins the naming strata beside sruth, ceilidh, seanchaí, and éist.
One who tends a collection with judgment — reviewing what is offered, publishing what is true, keeping notes on every ruling. Care for the commons, one decision at a time.
What a community agrees to treat as value in exchange. Currency works only because everyone expects everyone else to accept it.
Belonging to now. Also a steady flow in one direction — both senses are about what is presently running.
The mark showing where the next thing will land. It holds a position rather than a value.
The line that bends without breaking — gradual change made visible.
Made for one case rather than for all. Also a practice repeated until it became expected — both senses are about what a particular group does.
One who buys. Named by the transaction, which is why this house prefers vessel or participant where the relation is more than that.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Likely the tail of a longer name; flagged for the mis-cut band.
A sequence that returns to where it began. A cycle repeats without necessarily staying the same.
A single letter used as a short name or a drive label. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The gradual reducing of a motion's swing. Damping is what stops a thing oscillating forever.
The dark editor theme with the playful name — IDE night dress, spoken as itself.
Without light. Also of material that is hard to look at — which in this house is witnessed with honour rather than flagged.
A surface showing many measures at once. It exists to make a state graspable in a glance.
Drawn as separated marks rather than one line. In this house's boards, a dashed edge means the format is not yet in the lexicon — an honest unknown, not an absence.
How far along a dashed line its pattern begins. A named drawing property rather than a concept.
The things that are given. Facts handed over as the ground a reckoning stands on, before anything is concluded from them.
A structured store built so things can be found again reliably. Its whole discipline is retrieval.
A named day, by which an event can be placed in time. A date is what makes a claim checkable against a record.
A day and a time held together as one value. Precision enough to order events that share a date.

Dath (Irish: colour — the thing itself, before anyone has an opinion about it). Colour measured rather than eyeballed: OKLCH lightness against the mode's band, OKLCH chroma against the floor below which a hue reads as grey, OKLab delta-E between slots under simulated protan and deutan (tritan reported) by the Machado-Oliveira-Fernandes 2009 transforms at severity 1.0, OKLab delta-E under NORMAL vision because full-colour readers must be able to tell neighbours apart too, and the WCAG contrast ratio of every mark against the surface. THE VERDICT IS A ROW, NEVER A BARE SCORE: each check returns its own name, its own state and a sentence with the offending values written into it, so a reader never goes looking behind a number to find which colour is the problem. WARN IS NOT FAIL AND THE DIFFERENCE IS RULED: adjacent CVD in the 6-8 band and contrast under 3:1 are WARNs legal only with mandatory secondary encoding, while the normal-vision floor is a HARD gate that secondary encoding does not excuse and weak pairs are not masked to keep an existing palette validating. Ordinal ramps take their own four checks — monotone lightness, a visible step gap, a light end that clears the surface, one hue — because the categorical checks fail a correct ramp by design. It measures and never decides: nothing here has taste, and the two structural rules that cannot be computed from hexes are named as uncomputable rather than pretended at. No clock, no disk, no network, no DOM, zero imports.
One turn of the earth, and the span a life is lived in units of. Also, in this house, one continuous stretch that may run far past a date.
Short form of database. A structured store built for retrieval.
A compound fragment naming a database check. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
To take a thing out of running while leaving it present. Deactivation is not removal.
To ignore repeats that arrive too fast to be meant. It waits for the trembling to settle before answering.
To find why a thing behaves other than intended. Debugging is the disciplined narrowing of where the truth differs from the belief.
The digits after the point. Decimals state precision and say nothing about accuracy.
A choice made, closing the others. A decision is only real once something becomes impossible.
A full ordered set of cards, and a flat raised surface. Both are things laid out ready to be used.
A statement made openly and on the record. A declaration binds the one declaring, which is what separates it from a remark.
To read the meaning back out of the coded — reversal of encoding, faithfully.
That which turns an encoded form back into what it carried. Decoding recovers; it does not interpret.
What is added for delight rather than for function. Decoration is not waste — it is where a made thing says it was cared about.
To remove repeated copies so each thing is counted once. Deduplication is how an archive stops lying about its size.
Extending far inward. Of what is not reached by a surface look.
A named model lineage this house has worked with. A named system rather than a concept.
Short form of define, and of definition. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
What holds when nothing is chosen. A decision made in advance, on behalf of whoever does not decide.
To state what a thing is, tightly enough to exclude what it is not. To define is to draw a boundary around a meaning.
A statement of what a thing is, drawn tightly enough to exclude what it is not. To define is to set a boundary around a meaning.
Loss of quality by stages rather than all at once. Graceful degradation means less is offered rather than nothing.
A named power in a pantheon — in this house's architecture, the Greek names the realms wear (Athena's library, Hermes' bazaar): organizing spirits, never objects of worship.
Time deliberately or unavoidably placed between two events. A delay can be a fault or a mercy.
The handing of authority to another to act in one's place. Delegation transfers the doing and never the answering for it.
To remove entirely, at the owner's word. Bound in this house by the purge law: when deletion is asked, it is complete — and it is never asked lightly.
To carry a thing to where it belongs and leave it standing there — arrival as a promise kept.
A showing meant to prove rather than describe. A demo ends an argument by being watched.
A showing that proves rather than describes. A demonstration ends an argument by being watched.
To repeat data on purpose so it is faster to read. Denormalising trades one truth for many copies of it.
How much is packed into a given space. Density decides how much attention a surface asks for.
A thing another thing cannot work without. Every dependency is a place where someone else's choices reach you.
Those that rely on another to work. Every dependent is a place a change reaches further than intended.
To put a made thing into the place where it will actually run. Deployment is where a build meets reality.
That which puts a made thing where it will actually run. Deployment is where a build meets reality.
The putting of a made thing where it will actually run. Deployment is where a build meets reality.
The marking of a thing as no longer preferred, before removing it. Deprecation is a warning given in advance so nothing breaks unannounced.
How far a thing extends inward or downward. Depth is what a surface conceals.
The chain by which one thing came from another. A derivation is what makes a result checkable rather than merely asserted.
To obtain one thing from another by a traceable path. Derivation is what makes a result checkable.
To say what a thing is like. Description reports and does not instruct — reading one as an instruction is a common error.
To take a thing out of what was chosen. Deselection restores an option that had been closed.
Deciding the shape of a thing before it is made. Design is where most of a thing's fate is settled.
A computer meant to stay in one place, and the surface its interface imitates. Named for the furniture it replaced.
Where a going is aimed. A destination gives a journey its shape without being most of it.
A small part attended to on its own. Detail is where a general claim either holds or fails.
To notice what was there but unnoticed. Detection finds; it does not create.
